title: Rollup Plugin Configuration
description: Defines options for Rollup plugin execution.

$schema.description: Part of the JSON Schema standard, this optional keyword declares the URL of the schema that the file conforms to. Editors may download the schema and use it to perform syntax highlighting.

devConfigurationPath.description: Specifies a relative path to the Rollup dev configuration, which is used in "serve" mode. The default value is "./rollup.dev.config.js".

configurationPath.description: Specifies a relative path to the Rollup configuration. The default value is "./rollup.config.js".
